column2: Hal fi dhālika qasamun lidhi ḥijr
ʾalam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʿād
Allati lam yukhlaq mithluhā fi l-bilād
Faʾammā l-ʾinsānu ʾidhā mā btalāhu rabbuhu faʾakramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbi ʾakraman
Waʾammā ʾidhā mā btalāhu faqadara ʿalayhi rizqahu fayaqūlu rabbi ʾahānan
Kallā ʾidhā dukkati l-ʾarḍu dakkan dakkā
Wajiʾa yawmaʾidhin bijahannama yawmaʾidhin yatadhakkaru l-ʾinsānu waʾannā lahu dh-dhikrā
